summary: Primary-source review since 2026-11-13 found no newly verified material AI-specific labor-market evidence. ILO Viet Nam Nov 2 reiterates April exposure estimates, not observed displacement; previously assessed BLS payrolls, OECD shortages, IMF job-postings research and ILO findings are not duplicated. Exposure, postings, and aggregate payrolls do not establish AI-caused job losses.
